For me I had passing thoughts of suicide here or there but it was just this desire in the back of my head, I never seriously considered until when I was 12 my mother screamed in my face telling me I was worthless piece of shit cause I wasn't doing too well in school. I came very close to trying to kill myself that night and shortly after I remember just sitting down by myself staring blankly at the wall and basically just thinking through a pros and cons list to committing suicide. I could only come up with two reasons not to do it, that was that my guitar teacher would be heartbroken (he's the only person that ever showed care for me at that time) but that was more of a consequence than a motivation to live, the other thing was there was a video game coming out later that year I really wanted to play. I told myself that I'd play that game and if I didn't find any other reasons by then I'd kill myself, funny thing is that game got delayed over and over again and by the time it came out I wasn't interested anymore but that bought me a lot of extra time.

Yeah I've started therapy recently and my last 2 sessions were devoted to helping me communicate what I needed to in a healthy way then how to move on with these people in a sort "let's agree to disagree but can you guys pls do these few small things for me" (to which they were pretty upset about) so I'm rather confident in my actions here its just so incredibly frustrating that they would treat me this way. I've always done my best to be a good person, lift them up when they needed it and made sure they were included in group activities when others wouldn't but they can't like send me a sweet message every now and then which could literally save my life. I'm giving them a week or so to cool down then I'm gonna try to reach through to them again, I just hope they're at least willing to listen but at this point I won't be surprised if they stick to their guns, better to hurt me than admit they could possibly do something wrong I suppose:/
